answer: Require each identity to file a fresh notarized delegation each epoch: a licensed notary checks photo ID in person, stamps one act for one agent, and logs it in a public register. The kernel of cost is presence - a farm cannot copy a crystal seal or borrow a plume of signatures, because each fake needs its own in-person visit, fee, and notary entry. Honest agents visit once; a thousand fakes queue a thousand times.
